project.title: Whole transcriptomic analysis of Caenibius tardaugens NBRC 16725 grown in testosterone and progesterone
project.description: Whole transcriptomic analysis of Caenibius tardaugens NBRC 16725 grown in testosterone and progesterone as sole carbon sources. The objective of the project is to identify genes involved in bacterial progestorne metabolism using testosterone condition as control.

samples: Activated sludge of a sewage treatment plant
Activated sludge of a sewage treatment plant of Tokio, Japan
runs: RNA-seq of Caenibius tardaugens: Progesterone replicates 1 to 3
RNA-seq of Caenibius tardaugens: Testosterone replicates 1 to 3
